I played it flatscreen on playstation and was disappointed that the VR was so limited there.  I heard you could get UEVR working.  So after some headache,I got a decent VR profile, some HUD elements or UI are limited or unavailable but I'm loving it.  Project Wingman doesn't detect my HOTAS so this is the best thing for me in VR.  I use the UEVR compatibility patch (the one on their discord, unfortunately the nexus version has a bug where you can't use flares), and one of pande's profiles.  I purposefully do NOT use the UEVR nightly build from github because it introduces HUD elements I don't want.  Anyways, I'd like the game better without so much cringe JRPG dialogue, but oh well.   I like going fast, hearing missile lock tones and flying by jets I shot down.  I like hearing that there's a missile lock on me, dumping flares, doing high G turns and unloading missiles on targets while guessing their flight paths to go around obstacles.  Its a medium to high octane blast and I'm glad I got it. Admittedly, theres a Top Gun Maverick DLC that gives you overpowered planes, I'd recommend avoiding those until you beat the campaign on Easy at least, enjoy the older jets.  A few planes are optimized for VR, one is the A-10 Warthog (I know because you can see your body in that one). 

HOTAS support is there, but you'll want to find your input.ini file in your user's AppData folder to change the bindings if you don't like their defaults, because you can't change the default bindings in game.
